frame: Origin at the centre of the face. +X is the player's right. +Y points away from the player, toward the bumpers and the USB port. +Z points out of the face toward the player's eyes. Z=0 is the top surface of the main PCB.

body.grip_note: Grips are wider and fuller than an Xbox Series pad (153 mm overall). Target palm swell about 46 mm wide and 40 mm deep per grip.

sticks.module: ALPS RKJXV1224005-footprint TMR module, through-hole, with L3/R3 switch

module_envelope_from_axis.note: Potentiometer housings sit on +X and +Y. The click switch sits on -Y.

sticks.shaft: 4.0 mm with two flats (3.0 across flats)

tension_mechanism.summary: Rotating the ring changes the preload of an auxiliary centring spring. A POM disc fixed to the stick stem sits under a spring-loaded POM plunger. Tilting the stick lifts the plunger with the disc edge, so restoring torque is spring force times disc radius.
tension_mechanism.spring: compression spring, 0.47 N/mm, mean diameter 23.6, 0.5 mm wire, free length 9.35
tension_mechanism.cam: three-start helical ramp, lead 2.4 mm, with a detent every 30 degrees. Planned, not yet modelled in the CAD.

dpad.style: one-piece disc with a raised cross, rocks on a centre pivot

tact_switch.part: C&K PTS645SM43SMTR92, 6 x 6 mm SMD, actuator top 4.3 mm above the PCB, 0.25 mm travel

display.part: Waveshare 1.9inch LCD Module: 1.9 inch IPS TFT, 170 x 320, ST7789V2, on a carrier board with an 8-pin 1.25 mm connector
display.lens: 1.0 mm PMMA, flush with the face
display.cable: 8-wire 1.25 mm cable from the back of the module, near its -X short edge, to a connector on the PCB top at [-14, 18.5]
display.verify: Check the pocket and connector position against the Waveshare dimension drawing.

bumpers.switch: D2FC-type micro switch, 12.8 x 5.8 x 6.5 mm body, through-hole, plunger up (+Z), operating point about Z=7.0
bumpers.note: Each bumper is a hinged lever that pushes the plunger down.

hall_sensor_bottom_side.note: Linear Hall sensor on the PCB bottom. A 3 x 3 x 2 mm N42 magnet on an arm behind the trigger pivot rises toward the sensor as the trigger is pulled and ends about 2 mm below it at full pull.

actuator.summary: DualSense-style. A small DC motor turns a single-start worm. The worm drives a 20-tooth sector with an integral stop arm. The arm bears on a tab on the trigger. The worm is self-locking, so the arm holds position with no current.
actuator.motor: N20-size bare DC motor, 10 x 12 x 15 mm body, 1.0 mm shaft, 3.7 V, lying along X with the worm on the outboard end
actuator.worm: module 0.5, single start, about 6 mm OD, 10 mm long
actuator.wheel: module 0.5, 20 teeth, used as a sector

paddles.switch: D2FC-type micro switch, wired to the main PCB
paddles.note: On the back of the grips where the middle and ring fingers rest. Positions are starting points and may move to suit the shell.

rumble.motor: cylindrical ERM, about 10 mm diameter x 25 mm, one per grip

battery.part: 1S Li-Po 104060, 3000 mAh, with protection board and JST-PH lead

esp32_module.keepout: No metal, battery, or screws within 12 mm of the antenna end.

leds.part: SK6812MINI 3535 RGB, top side, firing up
